_help: One entry per ballroom door. The key ("1"-"4") is what each door's QR code carries. name: shown on the printed QR sign; matches the "Entry N" labels drawn on the map. x, y: where the You Are Here pin goes, in the same units as src/lib/floor-plan.json (360 wide by 304 tall, (0,0) top-left). The four doors match the doors drawn on the ballroom's south wall (y=220) in SeatingMap.jsx, numbered east to west (Door 1 is on the far right, Door 4 on the far left); pins sit just outside each door, in the foyer. label: where the pin's label goes, "above", "below", "left", or "right".
